results.title: Why AI won't replace video editors, but strategy will. | Jake Drake posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content:
The smartest video editors don’t edit 100% manually anymore. AI isn’t replacing editors — it’s upgrading them. When I started editing podcast clips, I used to spend hours trimming, syncing, and captioning. Now, I let AI handle the boring parts — transcribing, cutting silences, even generating captions — while I focus on the creative storytelling. Tools like Descript, OpusClip, and AutoPod save me 5+ hours per week. That means faster delivery for clients, more projects, and more income — without burnout. If you’re a freelance video editor, learn to collaborate with AI, not compete with it. The editors who adapt fastest will lead the industry. The smartest video editors don’t edit 100% manually anymore.  #VideoEditing #AItools #FreelancingTips #CreatorEconomy #VideoEditors

No. Clients pay for emotion + clarity. You can use the most basic tools — CapCut, VN, or Premiere Rush — but if your story hooks in 5 seconds and holds attention till the end… you win.
